conventions.form: EndpointOK (formal/lean/Formal/Core/Substrate/CornerNat.lean): for every data path P and every request path Q of a form, sum over P of each arc's upper delay + margin_ps <= sum over Q of each arc's lower delay, both measured from the form's common `launch` event. With a corner model this is EndpointOK kappa (path P) (path Q) (margin + |P| + |Q|) (bundle_band, one ps of rounding per arc); with fixed intervals it is shard C's 10a race check.
conventions.combine: 'all': every form must hold (default). 'any': the obligation holds if one form holds (RT1, RT1b: race OR structural).
conventions.names: cell-relative: `<lut instance>.<logical pin>` (I0..I5, O5, O6); `<u>.<pin>@pip` is the site-pin input of that LUT pin. The checker maps logical pins to the physical A1..A6 the router chose (routed JSON X_ORIG_PORT_A<k> / ROUTING sitewire, or FASM). `{I0|I1}` = max (data side) or min (request side) over those pins. Bracketed indices (ctl[i], lat[b]) are pipe stages.

arc_kinds.lut_arc: cell IOPATH from a logical input pin to an output (prjxray per pin/output: O6 45/124 flat over pins; O5 from I0/I1 44/152, from I2 42/150; FAST_MIN/SLOW_MAX ps). nextpnr SDF: flat 124.
arc_kinds.site_pin: input site-pin buffer of the physical LUT pin, SP[pin]; prjxray tile_type_CLBL{L,M}_{L,R}.json (fast_min, fast_max, slow_min, slow_max) ps: A1 (172,214,416,516), A2 (170,212,409,507), A3 (107,133,278,344), A4 (86,107,229,284), A5 (33,42,91,112), A6 (2,2,4,5); SLICEM A1 up to 531, D1 540. nextpnr SDF: flat 25 ps (then subtract 25 from INTERCONNECT if it includes the site pip; check on one SDF).
arc_kinds.wire: routed INTERCONNECT from a driver output to a sink pin, excluding the site pin (prjxray pips + Elmore RC, or SDF band).
arc_kinds.feedback_wire: routed wire from a LUT's output back to its own input pin (the loop wire; tighten.loop_wire).
arc_kinds.line: traversal of a bd_delay line (or request/DACK line) for one edge along a named path (chain/ripple/tap/fastest); expands to wire + LUT arcs per hop.
arc_kinds.env: a segment outside the cell (neighbour response, server, sender, protocol latency); resolved by the checker by walking the routed netlist when it is inside the design, else an environment hypothesis.
arc_kinds.cell_param: datasheet / chipdb constant (BRAM tSU, tHD, tCO, tPWH).

conventions.lean_sym: the symbol the arc instantiates in the cited Lean statement (dlmax, dwmax, wfa1, ...).
conventions.site_pins: `needed` = the obligation's exact form contains per-pin site delays; `roles` = which logical pin roles and on which side. The SDF cannot see them (flat 25 ps).
conventions.corner_rule: prjxray's two IOPATH triples are FAST and SLOW corners, NOT rise and fall (ArbCorners.prj_is_mix; prjxray makesdf.py:63). NEVER take a rise arc from FAST and a fall arc from SLOW. Modes: '1C' = both sides from one column, checked at FAST_MIN and at SLOW_MAX (or EndpointOK with kappa over a shared corner); 'box' = every hi at SLOW_MAX and every lo at FAST_MIN independently (always sound, pessimistic); '1C_both_corners_required' = a SLOW_MAX-only check is NOT enough (RT1b). A SLOW_MAX-only margin needs the guard As - Af/k (fast_neg_iff; As - Af if k <= 1, guard_universal). Rise = fall within a column (H_RF_ASYM unmeasured).
conventions.status: 'proved' = every cited sufficient theorem exists in a tracked file; 'unproved' = the inequality is not a Lean statement (extrapolated, physical reading of an untimed result, or no theorem).
conventions.exactness: sufficient | sufficient+necessary (a counter-trace shows the condition cannot be dropped) | sufficient+necessary_at_boundary/instance (tight on a concrete trace, not a general iff) | exact (iff) | sufficient+necessary_untimed (S/N in an untimed model; the delay inequality is its physical reading) | untimed_schedule | hypothesis (a named assumption the cell theorems use, not derived) | sufficient_by_arithmetic | see_refers_to | unproved.
conventions.rule_verdicts: exact | conservative | missing_term (rule weaker; `missing` names the term) | exact_arcs_missing_site_pins | conservative_arcs_missing_site_pins | rule_is_the_check | different_condition | none (no rule checks it) | uncheckable_statically.
conventions.check_scope: static_route (route + prjxray only) | route_plus_env (needs a neighbour or environment latency; static when the neighbour is in the design) | environment | protocol | structural | not_static.
conventions.guards_in_rules: tighten.py A, D, F, H, I, K, L add req_guard = max(0.2 t, 200 ps); skew.py (E) and arb_fork.py (J) use 0.772 early / 1.155 late (GUARD_LO/GUARD_HI).
conventions.tcheck_mapping: for one form: node 0 = launch; each path is a chain of 10a arcs [lo, hi] from node 0; data = the end nodes of the data paths; req = one node joined by the request paths' ends (the earliest change of any); setup = margin_ps. tcheck's PASS is then `verdict_sound` (every data change precedes every request change by setup). A shared arc on both sides (same element, as in setup_pulse) is CPPR-pessimistic under FixedRun (C-10a corr).
